message: ご指名の相手は？

name: Synn
message: 「When you actually mark off the space like this, it looks pretty small, doesn't it」
In the plaza, the setup area was already marked out with duct tape, and the materials had been brought in.
All that was left was to assemble everything the day before.

name: Ria
message: 「It'll be fine. We actually secured a space a size larger than last year's for the wind ensemble's performance area」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The lineup hasn't even changed. Besides, you looked at the floor plan and gave the OK yourself, didn't you」

name: Synn
message: 「I just pictured it being a lot wider」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, it's like that thing, you know. When you look at a lot where a house got torn down, it looks surprisingly small, right? When there's nothing there, it looks smaller」

name: Ria
message: 「So everyone's going to dance right here」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're gonna dance with yours truly, Ria-chan」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm, sorry. I already have someone in mind」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're gonna betray the promise you made with yours truly before we were even born!?」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't make a promise before you're born」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Before even worrying about whether you'll dance or not, you don't even have the height for it, do you」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-hitting right where it hurts……」
I didn't want to dance with anyone other than Azel.
Still, would Azel actually accept my invitation?

name: Melilot
message: 「If Sakura-kun asks you, will you dance with him?」

name: Azel
message: 「Impossible」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun will surely be disappointed」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is there someone else you wish to dance with?」

name: Azel
message: 「There's no way there would be」

name: Melilot
message: 「I believe Sakura-kun feels the exact same way」

name: Azel
message: 「I-in the first place, I'm not even going to see him」

name: Azel
message: 「Besides, Synn has Nanaka」

name: Melilot
message: 「Listen to what the other person has to say. That is the first duty of love」

name: Azel
message: 「...Is that so?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Who knows. It's merely a quote, after all. Did you hear it?」

name: Azel
message: 「Nanaka is in love with Synn. She has been for a long time」

name: Melilot
message: 「And?」

name: Azel
message: 「And so... Nanaka will probably dance with Synn」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun won't dance. Not unless it's with you, Azel-san. I have no proof, yet I just know」

name: Azel
message: 「...That's irrational」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is irrational, isn't it. Still, I just know」

name: Azel
message: 「Is it really fine for me to go out?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You must feel suffocated cooped up inside, don't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「However, haven't they deployed a search net to track down my whereabouts?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The academy grounds are not under surveillance」

name: Azel
message: 「I see...」
Melilot let out a long sigh.

name: Azel
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, it's just that I'm not used to this sort of thing」

name: Azel
message: 「This sort of thing...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「By nature, I'm quite bad at socializing」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that right? As a librarian, wouldn't you be dealing with people constantly?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Dealing with people and socializing with them are two different things, after all」

name: Azel
message: 「...Is that how it works」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is how it works」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm bad at it too」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. I'm sure you are」

name: Melilot
message: 「So things like persuading someone, or acting as a go-between, are the absolute hardest of hard tasks. It's completely unprecedented」

name: Azel
message: 「That sounds... rough. You have my sympathy」

name: Melilot
message: 「Normally, I wouldn't do such a thing」

name: Azel
message: 「Then don't」
Melilot gave a wry smile.

name: Melilot
message: 「I can't just leave it alone. Because I want her to be happy」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't quite follow, but who is this woman?」

name: Azel
message: 「If I'm good enough, I'll listen to you about this problem」

name: Azel
message: 「Or is it something you can't tell me? Certainly, I'm bad at socializing too, and I don't have that kind of experience, but I can at least listen」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's you, Azel-san」

name: Azel
message: 「Azel...」
Azel stopped in her tracks and looked at Melilot beside her.

name: Melilot
message: 「I thought a lot about how to bring it up, but I'll just get straight to the point」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Is this about Synn!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes」

name: Azel
message: 「...Ugh... I'm the one who said I'd listen. I'll listen」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is the reason you can't dance with Sakura-kun because the world will end?」
Azel's eyes widened for a moment, before she awkwardly turned her face away,

name: Azel
message: 「Th-That was just a stupid joke of mine」

name: Melilot
message: 「Or is it because Sakura-kun is a Demon Lord, and you are an angel?」

name: Azel
message: 「W-W-What are you talking about... Angels and Demon Lords, that's ridiculous」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is not ridiculous. Because they actually exist.」

name: Melilot
message: 「As a member of the Re-Crea investigation team dispatched to this world, you should know that best of all, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「H-How do you know that!」
A cold winter wind blows between the two as they stare at each other.

name: Melilot
message: 「Through data-based deduction, as well as investigation and observation of facts to corroborate that deduction.」

name: Melilot
message: 「After all, my job is to investigate and record as well.」

name: Azel
message: 「A human investigating Re-Crea... Melilot, are you from Kujou!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No.」
Melilot hesitated slightly before continuing.

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I am a Demon. Perhaps you have heard the name Nive?」

name: Azel
message: 「Nive!?」
Melilot pointed at the ground by their feet.

name: Melilot
message: 「What a beautiful seal. This is something only an angel of great power could create.」

name: Azel
message: 「You can see it!? No, if you can, then you shouldn't be a Demon!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia should have been able to sense it as well. Though I cannot say whether she could read it.」

name: Azel
message: 「You know Soltia!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You are the one who wove this, aren't you, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Since when」

name: Melilot
message: 「I only learned about the angel's seal very recently.」

name: Azel
message: 「...And when did you find out I was an angel?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ever since you transferred in, I suspected that might be the case.」

name: Azel
message: 「Then... becoming friends with me, and sheltering me, it was all」
Azel involuntarily staggered and stepped back.

name: Melilot
message: 「That is not true.」
Melilot stepped forward by that exact same distance.

name: Azel
message: 「Otherwise, there's no way he'd be so kind to someone as antisocial as me!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's not true. I understand why you might think that, but it isn't true」

name: Azel
message: 「But」
Melilot took hold of Azel's hand.

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel, you didn't get close to Sakura with any ulterior motive either, did you?」

name: Azel
message: 「No! That's not it! Anything but that!」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's the same for me」

name: Melilot
message: 「I can't offer any rational proof, but it's true」

name: Azel
message: 「Me too!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I believe you, Azel」
After a brief moment, Azel gave a small nod.

name: Azel
message: 「I... believe you too」

name: Azel
message: 「Do I have to call you Nibe?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please call me Melilot. That is simply the name of my clan」

name: Azel
message: 「Melilot」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you going to tell... Synn and the others about this?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is for you to decide, Azel. I won't say a word」

name: Azel
message: 「...Why? Because I」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're running away from Sakura because you helped the Virus gang by placing a seal to protect the magic circle from destruction, aren't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, you simply need to undo the seal in secret」

name: Azel
message: 「Undo... the seal?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Only Helena and I know of the seal and the magic circle's existence. Sakura and the others don't know anything」

name: Melilot
message: 「Once the seal is undone, destroying the magic circle will be easy. We'll make it as if none of it ever happened」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel. You didn't do anything. You never cooperated with Virus and the others.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's all we have to make the story.」

name: Melilot
message: 「As for why you went into hiding, we can just say you had urgent business back in your hometown.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It came up so suddenly that you didn't have time to let anyone know beforehand. Won't that work just fine?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There's no need to worry about a thing.」

name: Azel
message: 「...That's not all of it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Maybe it isn't. Still, nobody else knows about it.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Aren't you going to ask... why I sealed it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you feel you should tell me, Azel, then please do.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Even you will end up keeping secrets from everyone, Melilot.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone has things they can't tell others.」

name: Melilot
message: 「First, let's undo the seal on the magic circle inside the academy tonight. I'll take care of destroying it.」

name: Azel
message: 「A-Aah, aaghaaaaaaaaah!」
Azel suddenly clutched his chest and began writhing in pain

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel?!」
Twisting in agony, Azel slapped Melilot's hand away.

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel...?」

name: Azel
message: 「No... Don't touch me with such warm hands.」
Azel staggered backward.
Despair--and a faint trace of relief--crossed his pale face.

name: Azel
message: 「Tell Synn... goodbye... for me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「There's no need for that! Because none of it ever happened!」

name: Azel
message: 「If only we could do as you say, Melilot... how wonderful that would be... I truly mean that...」
Azel wrapped both arms tightly around his own shoulders.
He looked as though he were trying to hold back something threatening to spill out from within him.

name: Azel
message: 「It won't even let me deny it...」

name: Azel
message: 「It's no use... I... I even tried to kill Synn with my own hands」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm... nothing more than my master's weapon... Betraying my master is impossible...」
